name: template-build-checks
body: When the project's templates are loaded (startup and reload), the registry rejects: template reference cycles, a section accepting a slide template, a required-body template used as a field type, use of the reserved `_format` suffix or `notes`/`body` names as declared fields/sections, references to undefined templates, and example slides that fail validation. These are reported as templates errors (step 4/7 of templates-dir-validation), path-qualified to the offending `template.yaml`/`example.md`, and are distinct from deck (slide) errors.
